From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment availability matrix for Dedicated/Private security reviewers

Team —

Vertex Health is asking for a single booking that includes our Dedicated/Private deployment overview + a live security Q&A with regional reviewers (their EU DPO and their APAC security lead). They want a 60–75 minute slot that works for:

- Vertex’s internal stakeholders (EU: Berlin time)
- Zenotech’s APAC security lead (Tokyo/Singapore window)
- Our engineers (US West) to be available for demos and deep-dive questions

Two immediate asks:
1) Can someone put together a compact availability matrix (rows: candidate slots across 3 days; columns: US West / EU CEST / APAC JST/SGT availability) that we can share with their DPO and APAC lead?
2) We should include a short SOC2 evidence file and list of artifacts for the DPO to review before the session.

Constraints to keep in mind:
- DST changes in EU make late-Aug times tricky for EU participants; avoid very early EU slots that push APAC into midnight.
- If we can offer two alternatives (one APAC-friendly, one EU-friendly) they can pick.

I’ll own coordination with Vertex. Marissa — can you draft the matrix? Karthik — can you confirm which engineers can join live for 10–20 minute deep-dive Q&A (quant, infra)? Soojin — can you pull the latest SOC2 summary and audit artifact list?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Deployment availability matrix for Dedicated/Private security reviewers

Aditya —

Okay, I started a quick availability grid and attached it as an XLSX. High-level notes:
- Proposed window: Aug 16–18 (Tue–Thu) to give Vertex a few business days.
- Candidate slots (all shown in local times in the sheet):
  * Option A (EU-friendly): 15:00 CEST / 06:00 PDT / 22:00 SGT — good for EU daytime, late APAC
  * Option B (APAC-friendly): 09:30 CEST / 00:30 PDT / 16:30 SGT — splits the pain (not ideal for US night)
  * Option C (follow-the-sun compromise): 12:00 CEST / 03:00 PDT / 19:00 SGT — early for US, workable for EU/APAC
- I flagged Option C as our recommended starting point; it minimizes extreme hours for any single party.

I also added columns for who on our side can attend live (engineering, security SME, product lead). Karthik — fill the engineer names and which sections they can cover.

Attached: availability_matrix.xlsx (grid + timezone conversion notes).

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Deployment availability matrix for Dedicated/Private security reviewers

Hi Aditya / Marissa —

Thanks for pulling this together. A few quick items from Vertex’s DPO side:

- We prefer sessions within core EU working hours if possible (09:00–17:00 CEST).
- Please include a short pre-read of SOC2 scope + where our scope sits w.r.t. tenant isolation and logging.
- Can we avoid slots after 16:30 CEST — our execs need to leave by 17:00.

If Option C (12:00 CEST) is available that should work best for us. If you can confirm the exact UTC/JST times in the matrix I’ll triage with our CTO and confirm availability.

Also — do you have a redacted SOC2 summary or evidence bundle we can review ahead of the call? A 1–2 page summary would be ideal.

Regards,
Elena Müller

Attached is the filled availability grid plus the SOC2 summary Soojin pulled (redacted). Quick notes:
- Engineers available: myself (infra/serving runtime deep-dive), Priya N. (security/ops), Marcus L. (private deployment packaging). Each can join for a 15–20 minute Q&A block.
- DOCS attached: SOC2_summary.pdf (redacted), availability_matrix.xlsx
- Option C (12:00 CEST / 03:00 PDT / 19:00 SGT) is the cleanest compromise.
- A scheduling suggestion: propose two concrete slots in the email to Vertex and let them pick. I included Aug 17 12:00 CEST and Aug 18 12:00 CEST as candidates.

Marissa — please send over the two-choice email and I’ll create the calendar invites once Vertex confirms.
